gumtree_entries.description: DELETED o2: Parameter supplied to Match Rating Approach encoder is not of type java.lang.String

ADDED i12: A single-character input is rejected early by the algorithm and returns ""

ADDED i16: "ZZ" is far shorter than the second string; the MRA length-difference rule rejects them

ADDED i18: Identical inputs short-circuit before encoding and return true
ADDED i19: Single-character second argument is rejected by the algorithm
ADDED i20: Single-character first argument is rejected by the algorithm
ADDED i21: A space-only argument is treated as empty and the comparison short-circuits to false
ADDED i22: Neither name encodes to anything similar enough to pass the MRA min-rating check
